description: Connect the update-planner-parser crate to the acli CLI. The sync command currently parses documents but doesn't use the planner to generate operations. Wire SimplePlanner and DocumentDiff into the sync workflow in acli/src/sync.rs.

title: Connect acli to real Anki collection via anki-wrapper
description: Integrate anki-wrapper crate with the acli CLI to execute sync plans against actual Anki databases. This requires: 1) Adding anki-wrapper as a dependency (currently excluded from workspace), 2) Implementing the AnkiCollection trait for real Anki collections, 3) Wiring the DefaultExecutor to use the real collection.

title: Convert Art.xls to Markdown format
description:
Create a script to convert the existing Art.xls spreadsheet to the new Markdown card format.

**Input:** notes/Art/Art.xls
- Column 1: Image filename (e.g., pollice.jpg)
- Column 2: Title and Artist (newline separated)

**Output:** notes/Art/Art.md (or multiple files by movement)

**Format:**
```markdown
# Academic Art

- ![](Academic/pollice.jpg) -> Pollice Verso by Jean-Leon Gerome
```

**Notes:**
- Need to determine which subdirectory each image belongs to
- May need manual verification of image->directory mapping

See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Migration section)

Depends on: Image support implementation (Tasks 1.1-2.2)

title: Add MediaReference type to doc-parser
description:
Add a new type to track image references discovered during parsing.

**File:** doc-parser/src/types.rs

Add MediaReference struct with:
- source_path: String (path relative to document)
- target_name: String (normalized filename for Anki)
- alt_text: Option<String>

Update ParsedDocument to include media: Vec<MediaReference>

**Tests:**
- Unit test for MediaReference construction
- Test that ParsedDocument::default() has empty media vec

See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Task 1.1)

title: Add end-to-end integration tests for acli
description: Create integration tests that exercise the full sync pipeline: 1) Parse markdown files from disk, 2) Generate sync plan via update-planner, 3) Execute against a test Anki collection, 4) Verify cards were created/updated/deleted correctly. Use tempfile for test directories and a temporary Anki collection.

title: Integrate image extraction into MarkdownParser
description: Modify MarkdownParser::parse() to process images in card content. **Changes:** - Before creating a Card, run both LHS and RHS through extract_images() - Collect MediaReferences in ParsedDocument.media - Deduplicate media references (same source path only needs one copy) **Tests:** - Parse `- ![](foo.jpg) -> answer` produces card with `` front - Parse `- question -> ![](result.jpg)` produces card with image in answer - Bidirectional cards with images - Nested context with images - Multiple cards referencing same image (dedup) See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Task 1.3) Depends on: Tasks 1.1 and 1.2

title: Write tests: old vs new file state produces correct Add/Update/Delete operations
Add media copy functionality to acli
description:
During sync, copy referenced media files to Anki's collection.media folder.

**File:** src/media.rs (new) or src/main.rs

Implement copy_media_to_anki() function:
- Takes document_path, media_refs, anki_media_folder
- Resolves source paths relative to document
- Copies files to Anki media folder
- Returns mapping of source paths to actual Anki filenames

**Tests:**
- Copies file to destination
- Handles missing source files gracefully (error with good message)
- Handles filename collisions
- Relative path resolution

See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Task 2.1)

title: Integrate media handling into sync workflow
description:
Modify the sync command to handle media files.

**Changes:**
1. Collect all MediaReferences from parsed documents
2. Copy media files before creating/updating cards
3. Report media copy results to user

**Tests:**
- Full sync with image cards (integration test)
- Sync skips already-present media files
- Clear error message for missing images

See: notes/image-support-plan.md (Task 2.2)

Depends on: Tasks 1.3 and 2.1
